pull_requests.title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387992803556 from paid-chain contractions and a mixed-rank BIT supplier
pull_requests.head: codex/p104-chart306-chain-20261120
pull_requests.body:
## Mixed-rank BIT supplier

The two paid-chain contractions in this PR, paired with a 480-factor BIT supplier, give **conditional κ ≥ 0.00387992803556**. This raises the independently replayed finite lower bound in #7835 by **0.00000000000955**. The five inherited premises are `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, and `analytic_recovery`. [Construction and proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/PROOF.md) · [Certified result](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/RESULT.json)

The first paid factor determines the cutoff. Grades 1 through 4 use `10^480` and higher grades use `11^480`. Reordering the same factors gives a concrete paid tuple that takes two calls in one order and one in the other. Compared with #7835, the construction reduces the tensor from 832 factors to 480 and the required log₂ N by 21.8%. The complete application charges 36 BIT calls and 48 rational calls at the original signed prices. The independent replay reproduced the complete rational application and audit byte for byte and checked 54 strict and four functional outer conditions. [Independent review](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/review/REVIEW.md) · [Reproduction commands](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/README.md#reproduce)

At commit `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, GitHub's dedicated workflow passed the chart-306 chain and finite application. The shared package planner failed its onboarding-helper test and skipped its replay. The separate mixed-supplier replay and audit are recorded in the independent review above. [Chain workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44688740120/job/136129188933) · [Planner log](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44688740070/job/136129189017)

Please review the first-factor partition and the separate uniform and delayed-cover losses. Credit to Dugongue for #7831, Rohan Arun for #7835, and Ali Romman and the other P104 contributors credited below. Clear1nsight prepared this follow-up with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The enrolled target of 0.003889928046155 remains open.

## Earlier paid-chain result

On the exact #7786 rational word, contract paid slots 94318 and 87 (2 → 304 → 306) to 2 → 306 with causal restoration at nine readers. Then in the adjoint contract slots 94025 and 94019 (304 → 2 → 3) to 304 → 3, restoring all 14 readers. The complete finite application gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.00387990740712**, exceeding that round’s target of 0.00387981257853 by 0.00000009482859. The 48-call rational and 36-call binary service and five inherited framework assumptions remain. Independent human review and maintainer selection remain open.

## Source and overlap

#7786 head `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`, word `c447b6d5ba956fbe40834fe3c1bc69af2f225736f1b97ecd84b57bab9dd283cb`, layout `f7de788c4a559282d35a9fce42f841a0e8de5a4015db871e718f9245569b0aa7`. First candidate `320847d42f2655c3cc0fd29fe670ae77277e9c2f377c1c92f33d7df050872f54`; combined candidate `7660985e0b618cdbee13e4190a4c6d5f91fbdf01a8f7a5186fdde8b980c19b48`. Chart-3 #7804 fixed-port exclusion remains valid in its own contract; #7814, #7818 and #7819 cover separate chart-278/288 work. [Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19763075).

## Validation

The archive preserves both frozen words, exact stock identities and literal delta checks, full bounded-scalar applications and expanded audits. An independently implemented exact review checked all 1,289 outputs and 1,661,521 coefficients in both orientations. The combined application uses the independently admitted binary cap 0.0038799074072; the first replay with the looser producer cap failed the independent audit and is not claimed. The pinned cap wrapper patches one assignment in a temporary copy of the authenticated predecessor qualifier. Exact chronology, scalar conversions, cleanup, complete caller and signed invoice are included. See DOUBLE.md for details and reproduction.

The [earlier exact-head hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44658460073/job/136030433591) passed for the first candidate at `211e4ec20ccad8b9c5d2db6619544bede4e0ebac`. The [dedicated replay for the earlier head `14c74c6a67108f675ac1196a5f2415ead0920e71`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44660042728/job/136035750391) passed fresh source authentication, both exact chain checks, the capped full application and expanded audit. The shared planner status is separately tracked.

## Credit and review

Clear1nsight prepared the continuation with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate computational reviews. Credit #7786/#7781, Ali Romman’s #7776 carrier, tariff and caller, #7774 restored chain, and the framework contributors retained in predecessor notices. Please independently review both reader identities and the capped full finite application on pinned sources. Computational review is not independent human review or formal proof.

pull_requests.title: Prove the all-column native operators of the complete grade-14 multiplier
pull_requests.head: codex/complete-claim-assumption
pull_requests.body:
This proof removes `native_all_columns` from the complete grade-14 multiplication claim. For arbitrary binary operands of at most n bits, the fixed-tape time remains O(n (log n)^(1−κ)) at **κ = 0.00387992802601**. The original application needed five premises. This construction needs four. The limiting outer cost remains the main transform. [Operator proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/PROOF.md) · [Physical routes and leaves](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/ROUTES.md) · [Complete application](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/APPLICATION.md) · [Exact receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/RESULT.json)

The eliminated premise required the actual operators, all phases, spectators and whole-job adapters to work at every positive column multiplicity. The native one-column replays and grade counts did not prove that implication. This proof starts at the two words consumed by [PR #7835](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7835), follows arbitrary independent inputs through both recursive boundaries and supplies its imported ordinary interchange rate from elementary operations. [Original five statements](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/frontier7000/CLAIM.json) · [Exact word, phase and price inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/ORIGINS.json)

| Interface | Construction and verification |
| --- | --- |
| Complex | Regenerate 2,955 relative Clifford jobs and 208 absolute-phase boundary monomials. Check all 1,289² rational transfer coefficients in each direction. Lift the native chart changes across columns, while retaining each caller coefficient once. This realizes all 48 calls and 30,000 global normalizers at their existing prices. |
| Binary | Use each actual port's head line in the 134-axis caller. Lower the complete low/high cover permutation, its rational carry, the matched donor and inverse return, and both good and nonunit weighted leaves. All 36 calls yield the original 20,706 productive outputs and 107,460 paid positions. |
| Ordinary input and integer output | The elementary digit exchange funds one preparatory grade-14 stage. Its envelope 0.003864408313999584 exceeds the required seed 0.00385248. The four original priced stages then deliver 0.003879928026095. Both supplier rates and all nine outer cost rows support the original κ. |

**Remaining dependencies.** The four original premises are `owned_erasure` for private streams and suspended owners, `compiler` for finite chronological compilation and uniform closure, `precision_tape` for the fixed-tape movement, storage and precision prescriptions, and `analytic_recovery` for the outer decomposition, prime avoidance and exact recovery. They keep their original statements. The proof is specific to the grade-14 application and the words and weights it actually uses. The conservative constants are enormous. We did not materialize either full uniform template or execute an asymptotic-size integer product. Independent human and formal verification of the universal proof remain open. [Qualification and comparison with higher advertised rates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/VALIDATION.md)

**Verification.** CPython 3.12, standard library only. Run from the repository root.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/grade14-native-realization
```

The five scientific checks emit these markers.

```text
PASS_GRADE14_ALL_COLUMN_COMPLEX
PASS_GRADE14_ALL_COLUMN_BIT
PASS_GRADE14_COMPLETE_LOCAL_RING
PASS_GRADE14_FOUR_PREMISE_APPLICATION
PASS_NATIVE_ATLAS_BUILD c7173d46c95d1311b8b18a92c874fb7013c6e694aa8e9c0c256f0f1eaf1ede74
```

We reproduced the three original grade-14 receipts byte for byte. The new registered replay and the read-only, Git-free export replay passed. The independent physical checks cover 1,930,240 monomial basis images, 95,420,416 Walsh phase values and all 108 split rank-one projectors over Z/9 at four widths. Replacing all binary port placements by identity changes 27,972 basis directions. Dropping the mixed-role inverse return changes all 7,776 positions in that control. These finite checks support the written arbitrary-width proof. [Complex verification](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/check_complex.py) · [Binary verification](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/check_binary.py) · [Independent leaf check](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/check_leaves.py) · [Application verification](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/check_application.py) · [Replay manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/VERIFY.json)

GitHub's hosted onboarding test stopped the plan before package replay. The canonical CI guide still lists the historical 6030 replay where the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The same test fails on the unmodified canonical base. All six files it reads are byte-identical between that base and this PR. Direct package selection on the exact change selects only this package. Both local five-command replays passed. [Hosted failure](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44693694667/job/136145280358) · [Canonical navigation test](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/tests/test_research_current_status.py) · [Canonical CI guide](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/ci-verification.md)

**Base and credit.** The canonical base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. @rohanarun submitted the grade-14 cutoff at `43007c979859fa84ccc3a3509ccacc9620d181fa`, following @Dugongue's preceding cutoff. @Clear1nsight supplied the actual rational word at `14c74c6a67108f675ac1196a5f2415ead0920e71` and the binary word and expanded verifier at `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`. @aliromman supplied the previous mixed caller at `4f7c67ae387cc91580f469aeda4d508b372b9ec1`. @CubeJerry and the credited predecessors supplied the selected circuit and Clifford engines. [PR #7831](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7831) · [PR #7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) · [PR #7786](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7786) · [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) · [PR #7000](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7000)

Ross Richardson supplied the fallback implementation, Jose Manuel the recursive ordinary closure, and Nick Petalas the complete-cover counting argument. The operator proof uses the earlier monomial lowering, fresh-row and delayed allocation proofs, and the retained compact global router. Ali Romman prepared this proof, implementation and source-bound checks with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate adversarial reviews of the complex, binary and resource arguments. The source notices credit the rest of the physical, compiler and analytic lineage. [Full credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/NOTICE.md) · [Canonical proof and code pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/SOURCES.json) · [Coordination and review request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7836)

pull_requests.title: Selected native realization under four retained assumptions, with route audit
pull_requests.head: research/selected-native-consolidated-20261120
pull_requests.body:
## Selected κ = 0.00363005817 under four unchanged retained assumptions

This PR combines a separately reviewed complete-cover route lemma with its **exact selected #7000/#7001 native realization**. It establishes the required selected `native_all_columns` instance—phases, spectators, whole-job adapters and a noncircular ordinary seed—*conditional on precisely the other four original contracts*. The canonical selected five-assumption certificate is unchanged. This is a source-specific mathematical reduction, **not** unconditional multiplication and **not** a larger κ.

### Source-specific native realization

The selected binary word is bound to its own 636 rational frames, 2,374 MOVE pairs and 111 paired chart routes rather than importing the larger grade-14 helper inventory or price from #7837. A reverse-functional checker verifies the 38-role BIT caller; the source predicate replay covers 434,281 BIT and 2,190,400 complex scalar coefficient positions. The unchanged application replay checks all 14,400 phase contacts, both paid-owner lists and negative controls. The complete signed-Pauli/Clifford catalogue comprises 3,057 maps plus 104 absolute-phase boundary pairs, freshly replayed with identical logs.

The proof supplies full-ring good-leaf normalization, explicit bad-leaf fallback, complete fresh-cover right routes and inversion, equal route matching for coupled X/Y roles, common ancestor weights, entire tensor/spectator semantics and correct once-only scalar/LAMBDA actions. The recursive implementation strictly decreases width; its ordinary service is bootstrapped from **elementary complete digit exchange**, not assumed from itself. Exact cold-stage targets are `0 -> 0.0034 -> 0.0038507 -> 0.00385248`; their envelope and the selected required saving have strict rational margins. New N-dependent route expansion costs are included in finite template constants, not claimed free.

### Independent route audit and precision challenge

The companion review of #7837 proves the full low/high carry cocycle, inverse return and coupled-role donor criterion. It independently factors all 111 port matchers at q=3 and 5 (222 rational checks), enumerates complete GL₂(Z/3) and GL₂(Z/9), and checks 109,536 common-weight columns plus another 109,536 nonconstant route-invariant-weight cases. Six mutation controls reject missing carry, wrong return/order, route mismatch and noninvariant weights. The algebraic weakening from ancestor-only weights to route-invariant weights does *not* claim a new physical tariff or source descriptor.

A separate selected binary reviewer uses reverse functionals and explicit exponents rather than the author's forward checker. A separate complex reviewer checks **all stored and intermediate scalar preproducts** across 71,261 events, so intermediate division is not inferred only from final endpoints. The retained A=178, B=161, c=356 and W+26 budgets remain sufficient, with controls rejecting wrong phases, tensor-powered exterior scalars and premature unscaling.

### Reproduce / integrity

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/grade14-weighted-route-cross-review
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-native-four-premise-specialization
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-native-four-premise-specialization --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The selected package passed all seven registered commands in both author and separate root replays. Its 101-file tested tree, 60 authenticated scientific source extracts and strict source-history gate were checked on the remote commit. The grouped branch keeps both reviewed package trees unchanged and includes their original commits in Git history.

### Exactly what remains

`owned_erasure`: full blank grants, nonzero erasure, suspended owners and higher callers. `compiler`: all-size mixed-target chronological construction and funding. `precision_tape`: real coded-field movement, layout and retained backing tariffs. `analytic_recovery`: full decomposition, fine-prime transfer, coefficient production and exact integer recovery. **No selected assumption beyond the native instance is claimed discharged.**

Ali Romman's #7837 has priority for the general native construction; this PR adds selected-source binding, independent review and the unchanged outer application. Credit Chris R / Clear1nsight, Rohan Arun, the retained #7000/#7001 lineage and all notices. Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; this is not human peer review or proof-kernel verification.

pull_requests.title: A uniform multiplication proof for the 480-factor mixed-rank bound
pull_requests.head: codex/mixed-rank-uniform-proof
pull_requests.body:
This submits a constructive proof for the complete 480-factor mixed-rank multiplier. For every pair of n-bit binary integers, the specified deterministic fixed multitape machine returns their exact product in O(n(log n)^(1−κ)) time and O(n) maximum visited tape space, with **κ = 0.00387992803556**. The exponent is the one already priced in [PR #7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830). The result submitted here is the removal of the five research premises for that price. The complete proof includes written mathematics and partial Lean verification. [Theorem and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/README.md) · [Obligation ledger](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/OBLIGATIONS.md) · [Original conditional receipt](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/RESULT.json)

| Part of the multiplication proof | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Both exact native words, arbitrary column counts and signed port adapters | [Matched source and weighted leaves](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/WEIGHTED-REVIEW.md) · [Native source proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a7f99a5f5f919dd3ffb2987f90c1e7d6527feb1e/research/grade14-native-realization/PROOF.md) |
| Finite ordered compiler and cold ordinary recursion | [Finite construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/COMPILER.md) · [Whole-high allocations and six stages](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/ORDINARY.md) · [Kernel-checked actual prices](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/lean/CertifiedPrices.lean) |
| Physical ownership, historical backing and native precision | [Frames and grid](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/FRAMES.md) · [Complete complex service](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/COMPLEX-LAYER.md) |
| Generated transforms, movement, strict rounding and carry | [Construction from operand bits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/ASSEMBLY.md) · [Grouped Gaussian producer](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/GROUPED-GAUSSIAN.md) · [Recovery and complete cost](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/RECOVERY-AND-COST.md) |

The binary word has 36 native calls and the complex word has 48. The ordinary supplier reaches 0.003879928035646. The separately accounted CRT conversions still give saving 0.003879928035626 before logarithmic factors. All grouped Hadamards operate on the complete dyadic field. A discarded face and its retained core use the same normalization. The final decoder carries both source-length factors and both input digit scales. [Formal physical-coordinate decoder](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/lean/PublicGrid.lean) · [Kernel-checked cost inequalities](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/lean/OuterPrices.lean)

We built the Lean modules and replayed their compiled declarations through the kernel. Their printed axiom sets are subsets of `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. The finite compiler's real majorant, the transcendental Gaussian estimates and the tape running-time proof include written steps. The short-word multiplier of Harvey and van der Hoeven and Trudgian's explicit prime estimate are independent published theorems. The submitted all-size result awaits independent scientific review. It gives no practical cutoff. [Formal boundaries and replay instructions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/VERIFICATION.md) · [Evidence](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/EVIDENCE.json)
